note:
P3 disaggregated: the missing arm of the H200 weight sync study. Every existing H200 cell is
colocated (P3_RESULTS.md), so the claim 'colocated is ~5x slower than disaggregated' rests only on
B300 measurements. Worse, H200 colocated (0.40s TP1) is already about as fast as B300
disaggregated (0.30s), which means the method gap may largely vanish on H200. These cells measure
the disaggregated path on H200 with the SAME model, TP and NUM_ROLLOUT as the existing colocated
cells, so the two can be differenced directly.

Layout: actor 1 node x 8 GPU, rollout a SEPARATE 8 GPU pool. On this 2-node p5en cluster that puts
the trainer and the rollout engines on different nodes, so the weight broadcast crosses EFA -- the
same topology as the B300 disaggregated measurement. mem-fraction is 0.85 rather than the colocated
0.8 because the rollout GPUs no longer host the trainer.

cells.name: h200_p3d_disagg_tp1
cells.note:
Pairs with the existing h200_p3_colo_tp1 (0.40s steady). Same model, same TP, same
NUM_ROLLOUT=3; only the weight sync method differs. This is the cell that decides whether the B300
'colocated is 5x slower' finding transfers to H200 at all.

cells.name: h200_p3d_disagg_tp8
cells.note:
Pairs with the existing h200_p3_colo_tp8 (0.85s steady). Checks whether the TP1/TP8 step
seen on the colocated side (2.1x) also exists on the distributed side, where the transfer is one
buffered NCCL broadcast rather than per-chunk CUDA IPC with ipc_collect().
